frequency_question: How often does the Federal Reserve successfully raise the countercyclical capital buffer above 0% when economic conditions warrant capital accumulation?
membership_rule: Members are defined as policy rate-setting cycles or formal regulatory review periods by the Federal Reserve Board of Governors where the CCyB was actively evaluated for a positive setting.

cases.name: CCyB review and maintenance at 0% (standard operating environment)

coverage_note: 3 named review windows; covers the entire history of the operational CCyB framework in the United States.
known_gaps: Internal deliberations not resulting in formal public votes are unobservable, though structural friction typically manifests in prolonged stasis.
skeleton: Regulatory review cycles for the countercyclical capital buffer since 2016, decomposed into formal evaluation points where structural friction (inter-agency disagreement, industry pushback, or bureaucratic caution) either blocked or permitted an above-zero setting.
multiplier: 1 successful implementation out of 3 major structural review epochs
validity_reason: Macroprudential governance frameworks and institutional risk aversion change slowly across regulatory regimes.
